name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Segment.append_right
typeText:
∀ {γ : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance} {ns ms : List.{0} DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Node} {s : Nat},
  DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Segment γ (HAppend.hAppend.{0, 0, 0} ns ms) s →
    DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Segment γ ms (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} s (List.length.{0} ns))

source.code:
theorem Segment.append_right {γ : Instance} {ns ms : List Node} {s : ℕ}
    (h : Segment γ (ns ++ ms) s) : Segment γ ms (s + ns.length) := by
  intro p hp
  have := h (ns.length + p) (by simp; omega)
  rw [List.getElem_append_right (by omega)] at this
  rw [Nat.add_assoc]
  simpa using this
